To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the hybrid HPV6 L1/16 E7 protein was expressed and assembled into virus like particle (VLP) in Sf 91 insect cells.
HPV16 E7 protein was expressed by recombinant baculo-virus vector in the insect cells and then assembled into VLPs, the VLPs could be used as a potential genetic engineering vaccine.
the hybrid HPV6 L1/16 E7 VLPs were expressed in Sf9 insect cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of the hybrid HPV6/16 E7 gene expression vector, the expression and purification of hybrid HPV6/ 16E7 gene protein, and the preparation of HPV6b L 1/16 E7 VLPs.
the expression of hybrid HPV16E7/6bL1 gene in insect cells, the expression level of hybrid HPV6L1/16E protein in Sf 21 cells was 2 times higher than that in Sf9 cells.
the expression of hybrid HPV16 E7/HPV6b L1 gene in Sf9 insect cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study is a good start to the research of HPV6b L16E7 VPLs.
the hybrid HPV6 L1/16 E7 VLPs is quite potential in future research and development of genetic engineering vaccines.
the hybrid HPV6 bL1/16E 7 VLPs was expressed successfully in Sf 8 insect cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have cloned the hybrid HPV6 bL1/16E 7 gene, constructed the recombinant baculo virus transfer vector pVL 1393, and expressed the hybrid HPV6L1/16 E7 protein in insect cell line Sf 9.
the hybrid HPV6/16E7 L1 gene has been expressed in insect cells, the recombinant bacolovirus was constructed and the recombinant virus was successfully amplified.
we have constructed the recombinant bacolovirus vector pVL1392/HPV6b L1-16E7 and expressed the hybrid HPV6 b L1/16 E7 protein in Sf 91nsect cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have demonstrated the feasibility of expressing hybrid HPV6bL1/16E 7 protein in Sf 8 insect cells with baculo virus express vector system.
the hybrid HPV6/16E7VLPs expressed in insect cells is quite promising for further research, mechanism of the HPV infection, and the development of genetic engineered vaccines.
we can use the hybrid HPV6 L1/16 E7 VLPs as a vaccine against CA and the cervical cancer.
